svg.title: Embedded work — kestrel-rtos and EdgeMind
svg.desc: kestrel-rtos: a from-scratch RTOS and int8 neural-network runtime for ARM Cortex-M4 in C and Thumb-2 assembly, with MPU-isolated tasks, priority inheritance (high-priority wait cut from 65 ms to 15 ms in the kernel tracer), SIMD kernels with 4.1 times fewer instructions, an int8 CNN at 98.33 percent accuracy and 24 on-target tests in CI. EdgeMind: vibration fault detection on an STM32F407 with a 256-point CMSIS-DSP FFT and a decision tree exported to bare-metal C.
